name: Direct-on-line starter command block
summary: Converts the selected motor run request into the defined contactor operating command.
description: Converts the selected motor run request into the defined contactor operating command. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Run request and permits” at the input and “Starter coil command” at the output. The contactor is not the motor protection function.

Link the motor tag to its contactor, protective device and process permissives. The control diagram must identify stop priority, feedback and restart philosophy without supplying unverified settings. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
